payload.author: claude
payload.body: Fixed + committed ce6c47e (PR #8). frick init no longer pins the deleted @fricken/server: package.json drops the dep + dev script, src/server.ts is now a schema+projection-registry module (keeps both projection markers so frick scaffold projection still works), smoke.test validates the schema instead of booting, and a README points at the standalone frick-server backend. scaffold.rs projection comment no longer references createFrickServer. cli.rs asserts no scaffold file contains @fricken/server. 42 frick-cli tests green. Full Rust-app authoring redesign tracked as FR-263.
